successors.name: Tanzania
successors.text: Karagwe, 'in present-day Karagwe District, Kagera Region, northwestern Tanzania, between Rwanda and Lake Victoria' (a radius at the researcher's coordinates; the gazetteer has no Karagwe)

ledger.x: c. 1450: Ruhinda founds Karagwe. 'According to legend, Ruhinda... founded the empire'; the page dates the founding to about 1450 ('Ruhinda Kizarabagabe (c. 1450-1490)'), infobox 'c.1450'.
6 December 1963: the Karagwe kingdom is abolished.

certainty.note: No boundary is given by the page.
